SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(OCCURRENCE_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d') as period
TO_CHAR(OCCURRENCE_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as period
DATE_FORMAT(OCCURRENCE_TIME, '%Y-%u') as period
TO_CHAR(OCCURRENCE_TIME, 'YYYY-IW') as period
DATE_FORMAT(OCCURRENCE_TIME, '%Y-%m') as period
TO_CHAR(OCCURRENCE_TIME, 'YYYY-MM') as period
, COUNT(*) as incidentCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN SEVERITY_LEVEL = 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 END) as criticalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN SEVERITY_LEVEL = 'HIGH' THEN 1 END) as highCount, SUM(ACTUAL_LOSS) as totalLoss, ROUND(AVG(RISK_SCORE), 2) as avgRiskScore FROM TBL_RISK_INCIDENT WHERE DELETED = 0
AND OCCURRENCE_TIME >= #{startDate}
AND OCCURRENCE_TIME <= #{endDate}
AND ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId}
GROUP BY period ORDER BY period
